correctness.rationale: The cases center s=3, s=2 and s=0/1 partition all labelings. For s=3 each clique labeling is unconstrained (A). For s=2 only blades with labels restricted to 0/1 and at least one zero are forbidden (B). For s=0/1, no-2/no-3 labelings and one-2/no-3 labelings containing at least one zero are forbidden (C). Every C-admissible blade contains a 2 or 3; for r>=2 this guarantees that the center itself is defended even when s=0. Thus product factorization follows exactly; minimum weight3 occurs only for center3 and all-zero periphery. Independent brute-force direct definition enumeration confirmed every polynomial coefficient for five blade profiles (2,2),(2,3),(3,3),(2,2,2),(2,3,3), including 25 positive nonzero-weight coefficients at last profile; proof supplies all r,m quantifiers. Original RESULT.md at exact inspected Git blob SHA contains four ASCII BEL controls in the paragraph naming center-label regimes; verified exact 6940-byte source Git SHA and replaced only those malformed tokens with plain center-label-[3,2,0,1] in full supplied corrected scientific file.
